input.quote: Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, late-payment penalty or minimum/early-termination fee payable by Sparkling. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "interest" and "shall pay" return only Section 11 (payment of fees per the Fee Schedule). Section 17(b) lets Sparkling terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice with no termination charge, Section 17(c) converts the licence to a perpetual, fee-free licence and requires Garman to refund prepaid fees on Garman's default, and Section 8 requires Garman to refund all amounts if Sparkling rejects the Software. Section 19 non-solicitation carries no stipulated payment. All money flows on early exit therefore run in our favour, meeting the preferred position of no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties.
